$comment: Who a pull request may credit (scripts/attribution_guard.py). Owner decision 2026-11-09: commits and pull requests credit the owner and automation that is not an AI agent; any AI agent or model provider is always refused. Names and emails compare case-insensitively.

people.$comment: The owner. An owner email under any other name is refused.

automation.$comment: Reviewed non-AI automation whose commits are not GitHub App bot shaped. An entry without an email matches the name under any address that is not an AI provider's. GitHub App bots ([<id>+]<name>[bot]@users.noreply.github.com) need no entry unless their name carries an AI name.

non_owner_humans.$comment: allow: a commit author or co-author who is neither the owner nor automation passes when nothing about it names an AI (external contributors, e.g. on ESA-Blueshell repositories). refuse: only the owner, automation and non-AI bots pass.

ai_names.$comment: AI agents, models and providers. A bot name matches on any substring; a person's name, a trailer key and a credit line match on a whole word, so gpt matches gpt-5 but pi does not match pipeline.
ai_names.$comment_person_only: Words that mark an AI only in a person's name or address, such as "JorisJonkers Agent"; too common in prose and repository names (agent-kit) to match elsewhere.
ai_names.$comment_person_exempt: Names people carry: not matched in a person's name.
